method: Pinned dependency and Rust source inspection; runtime regex slot regression and fixed Unicode oracle are separate tests. No aggregate allocation or RSS measurement.

findings.normalization: Decomposition TinyVec<(u8,char)>, recomposition TinyVec<char>, capacity growth, plus stable-sort scratch of at most one decomposition entry per scalar for the pinned toolchain. The bound counts all components explicitly.
findings.captures: PikeVM current/next SlotTable scales by NFA states and capture slots. Canonical executor exposes whole matches only; explicit captures are removed before engine compile while original HIR and pattern remain.

excluded: Total regex compiler/HIR/cache heap upper bound
Process RSS or measured memory reduction
